blocks.text: Wheatstone bridge ek electric circuit hai (Fig. 9.30). Is mein chaar resistances R₁, R₂, R₃ aur R₄ aise jori jati hain ke ek mesh (jaal) ABCDA ban jata hai. Points A aur C ke darmiyan battery lagi hai, aur points B aur D ke darmiyan resistance R_g wala sensitive (hassas) galvanometer. Switch S band karne par aam taur par galvanometer mein current behta hai. Hamein woh condition (shart) maloom karni hai jis par switch band hone ke baad bhi galvanometer mein current na behe. Kitab iske liye Kirchhoff ka doosra rule lagati hai: do loops ABDA aur BCDB, aur un mein anticlockwise loop currents I₁ aur I₂. Loop ABDA se:

blocks.alt: Wheatstone bridge: chaar resistors R1 (A se B), R2 (B se C), R3 (A se D), R4 (D se C) heera ABCD banate hain; galvanometer G (resistance Rg) B aur D ko jorta hai; neeche battery aur switch S, A aur C ko. Anticlockwise teer loop currents: ABDA mein I1, BCDB mein I2, battery wale loop mein I3.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Jab B aur D ka potential barabar ho to galvanometer mein current nahi behta (I₁ = I₂) aur R₁/R₂ = R₃/R₄. Teen maloom resistances se chauthi unknown (na-maloom) resistance nikal sakte hain.
Galvanometer mein current zero hoga agar I₁ − I₂ = 0, yani I₁ = I₂. Kitab is se balance ki condition nikalti hai:

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki beech wali equations (9.48 se 9.50) theek nahi: −I₁R₁ = I₁R₃ ka matlab negative (manfi) resistance hoga, jo mumkin nahi, aur Eq. 9.50 ghalat chhapi hai (IR₁₁, IR₁₃). Wajah yeh hai ke loop equations mein battery wale loop ka current (Fig. 9.30 mein I₃) shamil nahi kiya gaya, jo R₃ aur R₄ se bhi guzarta hai. Aakhri nateeja R₁/R₂ = R₃/R₄ (Eq. 9.51) phir bhi sahi hai; neeche aasaan tareeqa dekhein.

Aasaan tareeqa: balance par galvanometer mein current nahi, is liye points B aur D ek hi potential par hain. Tab R₁ aur R₂ mein ek hi current I behta hai, aur R₃ aur R₄ mein ek hi current I′. A se B tak R₁ par potential ka girna A se D tak R₃ par girne ke barabar hai, aur B se C tak R₂ par girna D se C tak R₄ par girne ke barabar:

blocks.title: Ghaur karein (Point to ponder)
blocks.text: Kuch electric appliances (bijli ki cheezein) mein teen pin wala plug kyun istemal hota hai?

Yani jab bhi Eq. 9.51 poori ho, galvanometer mein current nahi behta aur us ki needle (suyi) nahi hilti (no deflection); aur ulat, jab galvanometer deflection na dikhaye to Eq. 9.51 poori hai. Agar teen maloom aur badalne wali (adjustable) resistances R₁, R₂, R₃ aur ek unknown resistance R₄ jori jayein, aur R₁, R₂, R₃ ko itna badla jaye ke galvanometer deflection na dikhaye, to R₄ Eq. 9.51 se nikal aati hai:

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab yahan "Eq. 9.49" likhti hai; balance ki condition Eq. 9.51 (R₁/R₂ = R₃/R₄) hai, jis se R₄ = R₂R₃/R₁ nikalta hai.

blocks.prompt: Wheatstone bridge kya hai? Diagram bana kar samjhayein (comprehensive question 9.3). Kuch electric appliances mein teen pin wala plug kyun istemal hota hai (Point to ponder)?
blocks.explanation: Yeh chaar resistances ka mesh ABCDA hai jis mein A aur C ke darmiyan cell aur B aur D ke darmiyan galvanometer hai. Jab R₁/R₂ = R₃/R₄ ho to B aur D ek potential par hote hain aur galvanometer deflection nahi dikhata; is tarah teen maloom resistances se unknown resistance nikal aati hai. Teesra (earth) pin appliance ki metal body ko earth (zameen) se jorta hai: agar live taar body ko chhu jaye to current is kam resistance wale raaste se zameen mein chala jata hai (aam taur par fuse ur jata hai), aur chhoone wale insaan se nahi guzarta.
